prompt_context: Cover the financial mechanism that linked a policy, institution, or market event to ordinary people and state power. Keep money, credit, debt, prices, employment, and political decisions distinct; never present a single bank or person as omnipotent without evidence.

tuples.episode_object: a clay tablet recording barley owed back at harvest
tuples.mechanism: harvest-dated repayment converts a seasonal food gap into a written, transferable claim
tuples.evidence_lens: dated loan tablets read against barley-price notations from the same archive

tuples.episode_object: a clay envelope sealed around a duplicate of the loan text
tuples.mechanism: an inner copy makes altered terms detectable, so the written word outranks memory
tuples.evidence_lens: excavated envelope-and-tablet pairs compared line by line for divergence

tuples.episode_object: a cylinder seal rolled across the closing lines of a contract
tuples.mechanism: sealing binds a named individual to the obligation and identifies him to later readers
tuples.evidence_lens: seal impressions matched to owners across separate tablets in one archive

tuples.episode_object: a hematite weight cut to one shekel
tuples.mechanism: a standard weight lets unminted silver settle debts by mass instead of by count
tuples.evidence_lens: metrology of surviving stone and metal weights against their inscribed denominations

tuples.episode_object: a temple register listing dozens of small outstanding loans
tuples.time_place_scope: the temple of Shamash at Sippar, about 1700 BCE
tuples.mechanism: pooling many small obligations turns a religious institution into a credit intermediary
tuples.evidence_lens: register totals compared with the temple's separate grain and silver receipts

tuples.episode_object: a royal edict tablet cancelling arrears owed to the palace
tuples.time_place_scope: Babylon, in a king's accession year, about 1750 BCE
tuples.mechanism: a periodic clearing of arrears restores taxpayers the crown would otherwise lose
tuples.evidence_lens: edict wording compared with the disappearance of older debts from later archives

tuples.episode_object: a field handed over to a creditor until the loan is cleared
tuples.time_place_scope: the irrigated farmland outside Larsa, about 1770 BCE
tuples.mechanism: pledging use of land, not the land itself, lets a creditor be paid from the crop
tuples.evidence_lens: pledge contracts matched to field-survey records naming the same plots

tuples.episode_object: a household member pledged against an unpaid obligation
tuples.time_place_scope: a village in southern Babylonia after a failed harvest, about 1740 BCE
tuples.mechanism: labour offered as security when a household holds no silver and no spare land
tuples.evidence_lens: pledge clauses read alongside legal collections limiting the term of such service

tuples.episode_object: an interest clause stated as a fixed share of the barley advanced
tuples.time_place_scope: the Babylonian countryside before the spring harvest, about 1800 BCE

tuples.episode_object: a shareholder pamphlet demanding better accounts

tuples.episode_object: a guild of florists trying to regulate dealing

tuples.episode_object: a grower's field of ordinary common bulbs

tuples.episode_object: a comparison drawn to a modern asset boom

tuples.evidence_lens: the reconstructed series compared with the anecdotes it replaces

tuples.episode_object: a printed list of ships, masters and destinations

tuples.episode_object: a policy slip signed underneath by several backers

tuples.episode_object: an underwriter's share of a risk written as a line

tuples.episode_object: a shipping register classifying vessels by condition

tuples.episode_object: a policy covering an enslaved cargo as property

tuples.episode_object: a court judgment on a disputed jettison claim

tuples.evidence_lens: judgments compared with the policy wordings they interpreted

tuples.episode_object: a subscription room replacing the coffee house

tuples.evidence_lens: membership rules compared with the earlier open-house practice

tuples.episode_object: a committee rule excluding disreputable underwriters

tuples.episode_object: a reinsurance arrangement passing risk onward

tuples.episode_object: a member's unlimited personal liability for losses

tuples.episode_object: a marine insurance act codifying policy principles

tuples.episode_object: a claim disputed over an insurable interest

tuples.episode_object: a foreign market competing for the same business

tuples.episode_object: an actuarial table replacing an underwriter's judgment

tuples.episode_object: a charter renewal granting extended privileges

tuples.episode_object: a monopoly clause barring rival joint-stock banks
